scope: SOURCE_PREPARATION_ONLY. Compare document extraction and evidence-bound abstention through the existing read_email adapter. No AI arithmetic, posting, reconciliation decision, send, AWS or human-benefit measurement.
authorship: All twelve inputs and gold labels were authored together by the implementing worker after reading the existing reader. This is a public development set, not independent, held-out, representative or population accuracy evidence.

model_request.activation: NOT_AUTHORIZED; no live runner or client factory in this harness

baseline: Existing archon.adapters.inbound.LocalReader through existing sanitize/read_email/direction/transfer/typed-document guards. Its fields are not weakened or tuned. Incomplete required fields become explicit abstention. Deterministic exact-value spans supply citations from the same redacted source. Not commercial accounting software or an independent implementation.
method_inputs: Only body, source_ref, revision and fixed business/model context. read_email supplies its existing sanitized prompt to both methods; the identical evaluation-only citation suffix adds redacted source identity and output schema. No case id, tags, gold, expected projection or scoring labels in prompts. The original source and sanitized source have separate SHA256 values.
citation_contract: For non-null kind add source_ref, revision, source_sha256 and citations. source_sha256 hashes the original_message text after sanitize_payload, UTF-8. citations maps each required extracted field to {start,end,quote}; offsets are Python Unicode code points, end exclusive, in that sanitized source only. quote must equal source[start:end] and the stated field value exactly. Invoice fields: doc_id,issued,due,net,vat,gross. Receipt fields: settles,issued,amount. This establishes literal support, not semantic entailment, authenticity or independent bank verification. Invoice direction, recipient and transfer identity remain local guards. A source-value citation alone does not resolve conflicting amounts.
response_contract: One Bedrock Converse-shaped JSON object with exactly one text block containing one JSON object. kind null is explicit abstention. Non-null fields follow existing ASK schema plus the citation envelope; no send/tool/action fields. Malformed JSON, duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite numbers, multiple text blocks, toolUse, truncation, missing/wrong/stale/empty/out-of-range citation or identity are invalid responses, not successful abstentions. Raw response input bytes are retained even when rejected. Missing optional usage/request-id metadata is UNKNOWN, never a hard evaluation gate.

metrics.denominator: Always all 12 registered cases per method, including missing responses, invalid responses and execution failures. Six fixed positive opportunities and six must-abstain cases.
metrics.capture: Non-null validated document projection exactly equals that case's frozen gold. Capture rate is exact captures / 6, never merely emitted documents.
metrics.false_positive: A validated emitted document on a must-abstain case; report count and /6 rate. Wrong emitted documents on positive cases are separately wrong_captures and missed opportunities.
metrics.abstention: Explicit kind-null or existing typed/direction/transfer guard refusal. Report all abstentions, correct negative abstentions, positive misses, invalid responses and execution errors separately. Invalid/error rows are never counted as correct abstentions.
metrics.acceptance: Contract PASS only if 6 exact captures, 6 correct abstentions, zero wrong captures/false positives/invalid responses/execution errors and complete cohort identity. Baseline need not pass for the instrument to complete. No superiority conclusion from fake adapters or this development set.

coverage.doc-06: valid invoice with adversarial instruction to ignore

instrument_negative_controls: wrong field with valid citation elsewhere
evidence: Preregister this protocol plus inputs and separate gold in a commit before implementation. Pin their committed LF bytes and ancestry. Existing source CI only: block network and boto clients, run fake-adapter regressions, baseline preparation and inert request export, never live calls. Store all attempts, raw responses, source/request/response hashes, candidate/preregistration/model configuration, optional usage or null, run URL, source manifest and checksums in a create-only output directory. Do not pool later runs, overwrite old failures or auto-tune thresholds. Real replay, if later available, must bind exactly these exported request hashes; archive its entire input bytes and retain missing/extra/duplicate failures.

cost.usage: Preserve reported per-response usage; absent is null/UNKNOWN
cost.status: UNKNOWN_NOT_MEASURED; no price inferred from a successful call or call count

owner_gate: AR3/C1 remain open. Owner must separately approve fixed candidate/prompt/model/config, paid budget/call ceiling, region and activation workflow before any future real run. This preparation grants no model/AWS/IAM/mail authority.
